title: A mandated tool call is honoured
body: The smallest disproof of the delivery bet every module depends on: whether a clause in a repository-local context file is enough to make an agent call a tool it was never told about in its prompt. The protocol and the decision rule were committed before the scored runs executed. Accepted at 20 of 20 against a rule of 18 of 20.

data.value: Re-run the harness in [docs/investigations/0001-harness/](../../docs/investigations/0001-harness/) at the commit that carries it: the runner, the scorer and the stub server are all there, and the stub's own log is the evidence rather than any transcript.
